title: Random Mob Blocks
description: It's a mod that when you place a block a mob appear on top of it
body:
Random Mob Blocks is a fun and chaotic Minecraft mod that turns every block placement into a surprise!
Whenever a player places any block, a random mob instantly spawns on top of the placed block.

🐔 A chicken?
💀 A skeleton?
🐲 A deadly boss?
Anything can happen!

✨ Features
A fully random mob spawns every time a block is placed
Works with all blocks (dirt, stone, diamonds, etc.)
Compatible with Survival and Creative modes
Can spawn passive, hostile, and rare mobs
Perfect for:

Hardcore challenges 🔥

YouTube videos 🎥

Multiplayer chaos with friends 💥

⚠️ Warning

Placing blocks has never been this dangerous… or this fun.
Building a simple house might summon an army of creepers!
